description: This line plot compares the Macro-F1 scores for two models—MATTER (ours), represented by a red line with circular markers and a light pink shaded area, and w/o material information, represented by a purple line with circular markers and a light purple shaded area—across varying numbers of tokens. The x-axis, labeled “Number of tokens,” spans from 0.6 to 1.4 and uses a linear scale, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, ranges from 48 to 58 and also uses a linear scale. The red line for MATTER (ours) begins at approximately 55.2% at 0.6 tokens, rises to a peak of 57.9% at 1.0 token, then declines to 50.7% at 1.4 tokens. The purple line for w/o material information starts at approximately 52.3% at 0.6 tokens, remains relatively stable around 52.5–53.0% until 1.2 tokens, then drops sharply to 48.0% at 1.4 tokens. The shaded regions around each line represent the uncertainty or confidence interval for the respective scores.
